events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your stand-out memory or track from the legendary Woodstock?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock 'n' Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His incredible voice and iconic presence truly live on.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice with The Pretenders is still as powerful as ever. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam moment or Oasis track?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Who's Your Bond?
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond film for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese character or sketch?
